meta.name: apple-maps-macos
meta.description: Search places, open routes, and run Apple Maps workflows on macOS using local CLI commands and shortcut automation with explicit safety checks.

copy.tagline: 通过命令行快速搜索地点和获取路线
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常在Mac上使用地图并想用命令自动操作
copy.tagline_en: Search places and get routes from macOS command line quickly.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently use Apple Maps on Mac and want to automate via terminal.

howto.what: 装了这个技能后，Claude 可以在 macOS 上用 Apple Maps 搜索地点、打开路线、生成地图链接，执行前会预览 URL 并请求确认。
howto.when: 当用户要求搜索地点、类别、地址或路线，且使用 macOS 时触发。

say.text: 帮我找一下上海南京路的星巴克
say.note: 触发地点搜索并打开 Maps

say.text: 从我家到机场的开车路线
say.note: Claude 会构建路线 URL 并提醒确认

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can search places, open routes, and generate map links in Apple Maps on macOS, preview the URL before execution, and ask for confirmation on high-impact actions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to search places, categories, addresses, or routes on Apple Maps while using macOS.

say_en.text: Find a Starbucks on Nanjing Road in Shanghai.
say_en.note: Triggers place search and opens Maps.

say_en.text: Driving directions from home to the airport.
say_en.note: Claude builds route URL and asks for confirmation.
